method: Read installed managed declarations and bounded proficiency component metadata. Decode serialized field alignment against those declarations; verify complete component consumption and resolve the script reference. No native source, bytes, or geometry included in this receipt.
sourceBackedConclusions: ProficiencyArmor inherits the base effect behavior. Init obtains the custom armor value from the registered proficiency row.
AddToDummy initializes the Armor record count to one and its remaining/full time to reciprocal quickness because the prefab is not end-on-turn.
The initial duration is approximately 3.333333 combat timeline units. It is neither wall-clock seconds nor a fixed number of character turns.
Native synchronized combat-time advancement calls UpdateProficiency, which subtracts elapsed time. At nonpositive remaining time, the count reaches zero, the Armor record is removed, and End runs.
ClearEndOnTurnProficiency does not remove this effect merely because a turn ends.
ArmorMod includes the active effect custom value plus any taunt armor. Other effects and baseline armor must be accounted for when measuring effective armor.

checkpoints: Before Censure: record baseline ArmorMod and any existing Armor-category effect.
Immediately after a successful native Censure hit: verify the expected custom ID, modifier, count one, and initial remaining/full time.
After subsequent ordinary native combat advancement: observe remaining time decrease, then effect removal and baseline ArmorMod restoration.
limits: Use a target that survives until expiry and has no intervening replacement Armor effect, cleanse, taunt change, or combat teardown.
If adding a passive UpdateProficiency observer, record before/after state and elapsed argument only; do not invoke the method to accelerate expiry.
